name: Skaldic Scolding

automation.text: The creature that damaged you is bombarded with a barrage of scathing insults and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, it has the Stunned condition instead. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

casttime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
